title: Debug a small network before you tune it
brief: Predict the untrained loss, flag a bad initialisation, pick a learning rate from a seeded bowl, draw log-uniform settings, and read the update-to-weight ratio.
hints: The untrained loss is the natural log of the class count. Accept a loss within 0.5 of that number, and flag a loss of ten times it.
pick_lr returns the learning rate at the smallest finite loss. The smallest rate is the left edge of the bowl, not the bottom.
Draw each setting as 10 raised to a uniform number between log10 of the low end and log10 of the high end, keys in sorted order, from np.random.default_rng(seed).
The update ratio is the norm of learning-rate times gradient, divided by the norm of the weight. It does not step the weights.
